title: The Judgment on Babylon and Seraiah's Mission
description: God proclaims the final downfall of Babylon and uses the kings of Media as his instrument. The chapter concludes with a concrete action where the prophet Jeremiah gives Seraiah, son of Neriah, a scroll containing the prophecy to be read aloud in Babylon, then tied to a stone and cast into the Euphrates as a sign of the city's eternal fall [ref:Jer 51:1-64|Jeremiah 51:1-64].
